name: qkd_hslice
structural_change: KV-FIX3 es2: ONE clock entry ck (was 4 CTS roots ck_station/ck_static/ck_boot/ck_boot_test, all tapped from the same die net clk_core_<stack>); es1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD FF -110 ps = cross-root internal hops paying the 100 ps die-skew hold reserve (boot->static ctrl_er->u_static.er -131.9, static->core -119, core->static -96, static->boot -95, test->boot -53; 5,695 endpoints; pc1 needed ~15k hold buffers). 6,999 sinks on one root (<15k). 0 cycles, bit-identical. | KV-TILES-C es2 (10-17): recipe 2 -> 4 with hold_budget die (FLOW-HOLD): the RTL is flop-first at every pin (PINCAP + ESPIN), so the inhold / outhold HB2 pin pads (pc1: ctrl_es[1] launch 411.7 ps through the outhold pad) are dropped and boundary hold is the die's; io_flop_at_pins keeps each pin flop at its face. | KVE-2 es1: dedicated ctrl_es pin register stage (ESPIN=1; pc1's launch_v copy was merged into the ctrl_es[0] pin flop by synthesis, fanout 20 at the pin). Q-KVFIX 0130 PINCAP (native FAIL of ec1-75cbc9b99: capture 435.7 host_rst_n, 218 inputs > 190 [ctrl_er 119, ski/sdi/soi/sfi 94, host/hbm_rst_n, ctrl_completion_v/we, bgi]; launch 232.5 ctrl_es[0]): every input pin lands on its own flop at the face: host_rst_n/hbm_rst_n synchronous capture (rn <= rst_n, regional sync reset), ctrl_er 261 b + ctrl_completion_v/we captured on ck_boot, ski on ck_station and sdi/soi/sfi on ck_boot, bgi_q is bgi's only load (bgo <= bgi_q); ctrl_es[0]/[286] pin flops drive only their pins (launch_v/launch_we copies feed the completion observer). Same outline, faces and v1.4.2 pin positions. Exact v1.4.2 per-bit reach-safe pitch6 W/E grant (all571596 stack-local bits <=498.696um), M5 pitch4 chain pins. Capture static lpc at station entry before boot status consumers: one strap initialization edge, no normal data/control latency. Four synchronous CORE833.334 roots; no clock exceptions. Boot pin captured once before related test-root consumers; uniform+1 boot-start edge accepted, existing1edge bgo chain unchanged.

job.purpose: KV-FIX3/KV-TILES-C es2: es1 + ONE clock entry ck + recipe 4 hold_budget die (no pin hold pads) (es1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD FF -110 ps from 4 CTS roots of one die net paying the 100 ps cross-root hold reserve on internal hops). | KVE-2 es1: native-PASS successor of qkd_hslice pc1 (CLOSED TT +97.54 / FF +3.92, native FAIL launch 241.7 ps on ctrl_es[0], 1 pin): the pc1 route shows yosys folded the launch_v copy into the ctrl_es[0] pin flop (BUFx3 fanout 20 -> INV -> wire buffer -> pin); ESPIN=1 adds a dedicated pin register stage on all 288 ctrl_es bits (+1 ck_boot edge on the command path to the elastic HBM-controller boundary); same outline/pins/recipe.

pin_regs.reason: Q-KVFIX 0130: the RTL (PINCAP=1) captures every input at its own flop and drives every output from a flop (station fdq/fvq/cq/aq/ffq, lpc_status, bgi_q, host_rn/hbm_rn, ctrl_er_q, cmp_v_q/cmp_we_q, ski_q/sdi_q/soi_q/sfi_q; outputs fod/fov, co, ao, fault_o, sko/sdo/soo/sfo, bgo, ctrl_es, land_er); io_flop_at_pins allow_none=false anchors each pin's own flop at the face. No recipe-3 wrapper registers. KVE-2 es1: ctrl_es comes from the es_pin stage (unique D, Q -> pin only).

cycle_cost: +1 edge controller->landing response (ctrl_er -> land_er, credit return er259) and completion observer (elastic HBM-controller boundary, owner 10-14); +1 edge reset assertion/release; status chain sk/sd/so/sf 2 edges a slot (head sees slot k at 2k+1, was k+1; boot/ack status only); boot chain 2 edges a slot (slot k boots 2k+1 after slot-0 bgi, was k+1). Command path (land_es -> ctrl_es) and station chain fi/fo/ci/ai unchanged. KVE-2 es1: +1 ck_boot edge on the command path land_es -> ctrl_es (dedicated ctrl_es pin register stage; HBM command latency +1 cycle at the elastic controller boundary, no throughput change).

reroute_reason.fix: es1 (qkd_hslice-es1-b9d1bfc48 / qkd_hslice_dn-es1-b9d1bfc48) EARLY_FAIL_HOLD FF -110 ps: 4 CTS roots of one die clock net charged 100 ps cross-root hold reserve on internal hops; RTL es2 = single clock port ck (one root); keeps es1 ESPIN/PINCAP pin stages (native launch fix of pc1 241.7 ps) ; recipe 4 hold_budget die (flop-first pins, no inhold/outhold pads)
